description: April 8 birthday meaning: Aries decan 2, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 8 birthday falls in Aries, in the second decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: April 8 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Authority is the theme of April 8. The 8, linked with power, management and achievement, joins the Sun about eighteen degrees into Aries, in the decan the Sun sub-rules. Interpreters see a commanding, ambitious presence, someone comfortable with responsibility and keen to be judged by results, who works best with real autonomy.

On April 8 the Sun usually sits at about 18° Aries, in the second decan, where Sun is the sub-ruler alongside Mars. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aries the Sun takes over as sub-ruler, lending this middle decan some of Leo's warmth and sense of occasion. The Martian drive is still there, yet it is often aimed at something worth being seen for: a cause, a team, a creative project with their name on it. Traditional writers associate this stretch with pride in the good sense, a wish to lead by example rather than by force. Generosity tends to come easily, and so can a sensitivity to being overlooked. A useful question for these Aries natives is whose applause actually matters, since chasing everyone's can scatter a strong fire.

sections.heading: April 8 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 8th gives a birthday number of 8 with nothing to reduce. In numerology the day of birth works as a supporting number, a practical aptitude that colours the Life Path. The 8, drawn as two stacked loops, is traditionally linked with balance between the material and inner worlds, and with authority, organisation and ambition. People born on the 8th are often seen as capable managers of money, time and teams. They may also be hard on themselves when results lag. Generosity with the influence they build is commonly regarded as the 8's best expression.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one April 8 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on April 8: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 8 is the 98th day of the year (99th in a leap year). By April 20, 12 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Taurus.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 8, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on April 8 include Kofi Annan (1938), Edmund Husserl (1859) and Emil Cioran (1911).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 8?
faq.answer: April 8 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aries, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 8?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 8 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 8th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 8?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 8 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 8?
faq.answer: April 8 is also the birthday of Kofi Annan (1938), Edmund Husserl (1859) and Emil Cioran (1911). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
